visual_elements.description: Light-blue rectangle with thin blue border, two centered lines of underlined bold blue text: '[3] Very Long Sequence' (line 1) and 'Vanishing Gradient' (line 2). Acts as a callout for challenge #3.

Light-gray rectangle, no visible border, three left-aligned bold lines: 'Short Sequence: RNN' (RNN in green), 'Long Sequence: LSTM, GRU' (LSTM, GRU in green), 'Very Long Sequence: FAIL' (FAIL in red); lead-in words in dark navy.

Unrolled 3-step RNN DECODER inside a yellow rounded rectangle. Three vertical columns (steps 1–3), each top-to-bottom: italic serif output label o₁ / o₂ / o₃ at top; short upward arrow; a group of 3 adjacent light-green square cells (softmax output layer) with the italic word 'softmax' to its left; upward arrow from the hidden row; a group of 3 adjacent orange/tan square cells (hidden state) forming the bottom row. Horizontal right-arrows connect consecutive hidden groups, labeled s₁, s₂, s₃ beneath the arrows. Dark curved arrows sweep from the orange hidden cells up into the green cells (recurrent context flow) with small curved arrowheads near the green groups. A red dot marks the first (leftmost) orange hidden cell, arrival point of the red connector arrow from the encoder.

Unrolled 3-step RNN ENCODER inside a peach rounded rectangle. Top row: three groups of 3–4 adjacent pale-pink square cells (hidden states) connected left-to-right by arrows labeled h₁ and h₂ (italic serif, above the arrows); a red dot sits at the right end of the third group (final hidden state). Middle band: italic serif labels 'embedding x₁', 'embedding x₂', 'embedding x₃'. Bottom: three groups of 3 adjacent tan square cells (embedding vectors), each with an upward arrow to its embedding label, and italic input labels x₁, x₂, x₃ beneath the groups.

BACKPROPAGATION THROUGH TIME panel: white rectangle with red border. Top: wide red horizontal curly-brace/arc spanning nearly the full box width; below it 'Back Propagation' in red bold italic; below that a long horizontal red arrow POINTING LEFT with a large filled red dot at its right end. Middle: a row of ~12 [?] small white squares with red borders, each containing a black nabla (∇); square and symbol size increases progressively from left to right. Below: a row of 11 small pink rectangles linked by a thin horizontal line (hidden-state chain). Bottom: 11 light-green squares with green borders labeled x₀, x₁, x₂, x₃, x₄, x₅, x₆, x₇, x₈, x₉, x₁₀ (bold black text), each with a thin green upward arrow connecting to the pink chain.

Two connector curves in the slide center: (1) a thin blue curved line starting at the right edge of the blue callout box, sweeping right and down (passing the decoder's left edge) to a red dot at the encoder's final hidden state; (2) a short red curved arrow from that encoder red dot pointing up-right to a red dot on the decoder's first orange hidden cell — indicating the encoder's final state feeds the decoder.
Slide-number badge: yellow filled circle with thin dark outline containing the bold black numeral '9'.
